page.overview:
Who is Layle?

Layle is the protagonist of Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: The Crystal Bearers. He is a Clavat who, unlike other Clavats, possesses a unique trait: Layle is a Crystal Bearer, someone who is born with a Crystal shard inside their body. This crystal provides Layle with gravity-based telekinetic powers (Gyrokinesis or Gravitokinesis). When the story begins, Layle is already well-known for his abilities and takes on jobs as a mercenary for hire.

Layle was on what he calls a "boring escort mission", guarding the enormous new passenger airship, the Alexis, on its maiden voyage. What seemed like a passive mission quickly became more dangerous than expected as a pack of Zu appeared, poised to attack the ship. Layle leapt off his escort ship, armed with a machine gun, and demonstrated his bearer powers for the first time—using his gravity-based telekinesis to hold his weapon, as well as levitating towards the deck, where a young Selkie woman, who was taking pictures of the event, and Jegran, the lilty high commander who had hired Layle and Keiss, stand among red shattered corpses of the monsters. A portal remained open in front of them. Layle used his powers to pull a member of the lost Yuke tribe out of the portal and onto the ship. The Yuke used a Crystal Idol to absorb the crystal shards aboard the airship. After a brief spat between Layle and the Yuke, whom he called "Goldenrod", the Yuke escaped on a Zu and flew away, unaware that Layle had swiped the Crystal Idol from them during the fight.

Jegran ordered Keiss to pick him up in the smaller aircraft that he had been piloting and to abandon the airship and its other passengers, but Layle used his abilities to power the ship enough to steer through a canyon and crash-land in the Queen's Garden of the capital city, Alfitaria. As Keiss headed off with Jegran to set up the contract to go after the Yuke for thirty million gil, Layle met a Lilty girl and later saw a group of Lilty guards chase Belle, the Selkie who was taking pictures on the airship. The guards soon went after Layle for using arcane magic within Alfitaria, so Layle and Belle fled from the scene using a chocobo-drawn cart outside the capital building.

The cavalry chased them off a cliff, where they found the entrance to the Subterranean Ruins. Layle uncovered a creation myth about four governing crystals that together formed the Crystal Principle. Before he cold finish reading the myth, he saved Belle from falling to her death after he realized that the place was unstable. After traversing through the ruins, Belle and Layle found themselves in chamber with a giant glowing crystal. "Goldenrod" stood waiting by the giant crystal and told Layle that they were there for the Resurrection. Keiss reappeared and unsuccessfully attacked the Yuke with Layle. The Idol that Layle had stolen began to glow and emitted a wave of energy, creating a branch from the crystal floating in the center of the room.
